# VantaDB

> VantaDB is an embedded persistent memory and hybrid retrieval engine for AI
> agents. Rust core; Python, TypeScript/Node and WASM bindings; an HTTP API and
> an MCP server. Published to crates.io, PyPI and npm.

Every link below points to the raw Markdown source, not a rendered page. Read the
page you need; do not read this file end to end. This index covers the
531 documentation pages; it deliberately omits the 193 task files,
which are work items rather than documentation. The full inventory of every file
is in docs/index.md in the repository.

## Start here

- [VantaDB Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/README.md): Welcome to the VantaDB documentation vault
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/index.md): Section index.
- [VantaDB Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/index.md): Canonical index of the VantaDB documentation corpus.
- [specs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/specs/index.md): Section index.
- [End-user documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/index.md): Section index.
- [VantaDB Wiki](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/index.md): Wiki documental de VantaDB: navegación por audiencia y mapa de cobertura del motor, bindings, servidor, MCP y ecosistema, basada en el código presente.

Decisión: el hogar es el wrapper vantadb-server
- [ADR-0055: Multi-escritor — LWW explícito con detección de conflicto (escenario federación v1)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0055-multi-writer-merge-lww.md): Una estrategia multi-escritor declarada: escritores que convergen vía la ruta de merge; LWW explícito sobre (updated_at_ms, contenido canónico) + conflicto detectado en empate temporal; merge_lock; upgrade vector-clock/CRDT-lite declarado.
- [ADR-0056: Object storage path — snapshot-level first, segment-level on the Pro/Cloud trigger, native backend deferred](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0056-object-storage-path.md): Object storage enters through snapshot-level backup/DR (BIZ-14) now; segment-level WAL shipping is the design for the Pro/Cloud trigger; a native object-storage backend is deferred as a new-engine project
- [ADR-0057: Encryption at rest — envelope-cipher wiring of the core on-disk artifacts (WAL, HNSW, VantaFile, backend-KV)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0057-encryption-at-rest.md): Wires the existing `encryption` feature to the real write paths with per-artifact AEAD envelopes, a wrapped-DEK key hierarchy with rotation, a provably-unique nonce scheme, and a declared no-in-place-migration policy; corrects the false SECURITY.md claim (FIND-407) by making it true, opt-in and bounded.
- [ADR-0058: Native sparse vectors — verified representation, metric, and coexistence with BM25](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0058-sparse-vectors-native-verified.md): Sparse vectors are native in VantaDB — SparseVector(BTreeMap<u32, f32>) at src/node/vector_data.rs:30, scored with DistanceMetric::SparseDot, fused with BM25 and dense via RRF; restates ADR-0011 with the code references verified against the 0.9.0 tree
- [ADR-0059: Storage-path env var unification — `VANTADB_STORAGE_PATH` is the only name](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0059-storage-path-env-unification.md): The VANTA_DB / VANTADB_STORAGE_PATH coexistence decided in ADR-0012 is gone: the CLI --db flag and Config::from_env() both read VANTADB_STORAGE_PATH, and VANTA_DB is read nowhere in the tree (FIND-89 consolidation, verified 2026-10-20)
- [ADR-0060: On-disk compatibility v0.9.0 → v0.10.0 — open in place, lazy index rebuild, no implicit encryption](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0060-on-disk-compatibility-v090-v0100.md): Every persisted schema/version between v0.9.0 and v0.10.0 is inventoried and classified: primary formats are byte-compatible so v0.9.0 databases open in place, secondary index state self-heals at open, and encryption of an existing database stays out of the open path (ADR-0057 D7)
- [ADR-0061: Implicit WAL transactions for multi-chunk put_batch — all-or-nothing batches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/ADR-0061-implicit-batch-transactions.md): Every put_batch is framed in an implicit WAL transaction (Begin/Prepare/Commit) reusing the 2PC markers shipped before v0.9.0, with a dedicated txn id, one insert_lock for the whole batch, and recovery-side discard+undo — zero on-disk format change
- [Decisiones No Tomadas — Registro de descartes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/architecture/adr/DECISIONS-NOT-TAKEN.md): Registro consolidado de features/decisiones evaluadas y rechazadas o diferidas, con razón y fuente — evita re-litigar descartes sin evidencia nueva.

- [How Hybrid Search Actually Works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/blog/how_hybrid_search_works.md): How lexical and vector candidates contribute to native rank fusion, without confusing embeddings with index algorithms
- [Introducing VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/blog/introducing_vantadb.md): An introduction to VantaDB 0.9.0, its embedded memory workflow, and the limits of its guarantees

- [Privacy & local LLMs — what VantaDB guarantees (and what it doesn't)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/PRIVACY.md): The exact privacy guarantees of the local-first stack — redaction-on-write, encrypted originals, certified delete, injection governance — with commands and a covered / not covered table

## API reference

- [API HTTP (`vantadb-server`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/http.md): Servidor HTTP con axum: endpoints verificados, auth/RBAC por namespace, maintenance, snapshots, skills y modo MCP.
- [API MCP (`vantadb-mcp`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/mcp.md): Servidor Model Context Protocol stdio JSON-RPC 2.0: lanzamiento, herramientas, handlers y límite single-writer.
- [API de Node.js nativo (`vantadb-node`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/node.md): Binding napi-rs para Node.js: estado de publicación, superficie frente al wrapper TS y diferencias verificadas.
- [API de Python (`vantadb-py`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/python.md): Binding PyO3 publicado en PyPI: Client, sub-clientes por dominio, AsyncClient, superficie verificada y diferencias frente a otros transportes.
- [API de Rust (crate `vantadb`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/rust.md): Entrada embebida al motor: Embedded, Config, tipos centrales y re-exportaciones, con el snapshot canónico de superficie pública.
- [API de TypeScript (npm `vantadb`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/typescript.md): Wrapper TypeScript en npm: sub-clientes por dominio, clase Client sobre WASM por defecto y ruta nativa opcional vía vantadb-node.
- [API de WASM (`vantadb-wasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/wasm.md): Binding wasm-bindgen: persistencia OPFS/IDB por runtime, contadores de saneamiento observables y límites del target wasm32.
- [Bindings Namespace Map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/BINDINGS_NAMESPACES.md): Rules for the migration window
- [Certified delete - purge certificates (VER-02)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/CERTIFIED_DELETE.md): Per-surface purge certificate emitted by delete (CLI/MCP/Rust): residue inventory for store, JSON-shredded metadata, indexes and WAL tombstone; integrity hash, VER-01 chain reference and documented limits (logical vs physical purge, backups, exports)
- [Compatibility Matrix & 1.0 Readiness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/COMPATIBILITY.md): What each public API surface promises, how that promise is enforced
- [Deprecations Registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/DEPRECATIONS.md): Concrete deprecations of the public API surfaces and their removal windows
- [Embedded SDK Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/EMBEDDED_SDK.md): Source: src/sdk/mod.rs, src/sdk/builder.rs, src/sdk/api/.rs, src/sdk/graph.rs, src/sdk/search/mod.rs
- [Embeddings — BYO-Vector + embed-local](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/EMBEDDINGS.md): VantaDB is BYO-vector by default (“does not embed text for you”) and offers an opt-in local embedding path via the embed-local Cargo feature. No breaking changes — EmbeddingProvider is additive
- [GraphRAG API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/GRAPH_RAG.md): GraphRAG (seed → expand → retrieve → context) is exposed by the Rust SDK and all four bindings — Python, WASM, TypeScript and Node — with one canonical wire shape
- [Memory interchange format (JSONL v2)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/MEMORY_INTERCHANGE_FORMAT.md): The JSONL v2 contract shared by VantaDB export, import and the third-party importers (Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Letta): mapping tables, integrity manifest, frontier-format mapping, declared limits
- [Memory scopes: multi-level isolation model for hosts (MEMG-25 spec)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/memory-scopes.md): Spec-first scope model for memory hosts: scope levels, visibility, trust, authority, provenance, validity, retention, owner and writer; fields, defaults and wire; no enforcement
- [Node.js Native SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/NODE_SDK.md): vantadb-node is the native Node.js binding for VantaDB, built with
- [Paridad entre transportes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/wiki/api/parity.md): Qué se promete igual entre Rust, Python, WASM, TS, Node, HTTP y MCP: matrices verificadas, runner de conformidad y divergencias declaradas.
- [Public Surface Manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/SURFACE_MANIFEST.md): Generated inventory of every public surface with status and version
- [Python SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/PYTHON_SDK.md): Python SDK reference — Client, memory records, cognitive layer (memory_capture/memory_recall), async client and typed errors
- [Scoring Semantics — VantaDB Official Score Contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/scores.md): VantaDB hybrid search combines two independent rankers
- [Search Capability Parity — VantaDB vs Milvus vs Qdrant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/SEARCH_PARITY.md): 1. topk semantics under groupby — VantaDB caps total hits; Milvus/Qdrant cap the number of groups. Choose topk = groups × groupsize to emulate the vendor behavior
- [Semantic events and provenance log (MEMG-26 spec)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/memory-events.md): Spec-first semantic event model for causal memory history: event types, envelope fields, causal links and wire rules; a layer over VantaDB, not a WAL replacement
- [Shared memory: scopes, grants, and revocation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/SHARING.md): Multi-agent sharing over the existing permission checker: scope mapping, grants, revocation semantics, checked reads and writes, and declared boundaries
- [Storage formats — on-disk versions and the encrypted variants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/STORAGE_FORMATS.md): The on-disk format contract of VantaDB: the format versions of the WAL, the VantaFile segments, the HNSW index image and the encryption registry, the encrypted variants behind the `encryption` feature, and the constants that name them.
- [TypeScript SDK Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/TS_SDK.md): Create a new in-memory instance. Accepts an optional Config object. To use persistent storage, call connect() or open() instead
- [Vanta Memory Engine — API Reference (`vanta-memory`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/VANTA_MEMORY.md): LLM-driven crate for agent memory: L0 capture, L1 extraction/dedup, L2 scenes, L3 persona, scoped recall, context engine (compression), offload, and wiki generation.
- [VantaDB Error Handling Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/ERROR_HANDLING.md): This is the canonical contract for how VantaDB surfaces errors across every
- [VantaDB HTTP API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/HTTP_API.md): Default: http://127.0.0.1:8080
- [VantaDB IQL Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/IQL.md): The parser implements IQL version 4 (adds the AS OF valid-time clause, LIMIT/OFFSET pagination, and COUNT/SUM/GROUP BY aggregation). The version is exposed as IQL_VERSION
- [VantaDB Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/MCP.md): MCP server reference — tools, profiles, and the current implementation version (tracked below)
- [Versioning & Stability Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/VERSIONING.md): VantaDB follows Semantic Versioning with the standard
- [WAL Integrity — tamper-evident hash-chain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WAL_INTEGRITY.md): Hash-chain per WAL record (VER-01): detects altered, removed or reordered frames with exact position; documented limits (suffix truncation, consistent rewrite, archived segments) and on-demand detection via vanta-cli verify
- [WASM API Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_API.md): This page is the canonical entry point for VantaDB's WebAssembly surface — the
- [WASM Persistence Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_PERSISTENCE.md): How VantaDB persists data in the browser: what exists, what the verified
- [WASM Standalone Console (Vanta Studio — mode `wasm`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WASM_STANDALONE.md): The Vanta Studio console can run 100% in the browser with no server: the
- [Write receipts (VER-10) — attestation of writes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/WRITE_RECEIPTS.md): Verifiable write receipts emitted by put_certified (Rust SDK): content binding (sha256), VER-01 chain reference, canonical surfaces and declared limits; point-in-time verification via schema, integrity hash and live re-scan
- [vanta-proxy Reference (Endpoints, Opt-in Features, Config)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/api/PROXY.md): vanta-proxy is a transparent LLM wire proxy: by default it forwards bytes

- [Backlog de extracción — AutoGen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/autogen.md): Candidatas del informe autogen: adapter Memory gobernado, manifiesto de sesión, budget con reinyección idempotente, refs de handoff y export tipado prevalidado
- [Backlog de extracción — Chroma](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/chroma.md): Candidatas del informe chroma: recibo de mutación por dominios, materialización ordenada, dominio efectivo de filtros, publicación/retención de generaciones, auditoría offline y contrato de backend
- [Backlog de extracción — CodeGraph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/codegraph.md): Candidatas del informe CodeGraph: frescura revisionada de la evidencia entregada, publicación por generación de fuente, referencias pendientes, límite dinámico y puerto visual
- [Backlog de extracción — Cognee](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/cognee.md): Candidatas del informe cognee: readiness por hitos, ownership de derivados, resultado por etapa, orden de locks, update incremental, contexto autorizado, promoción de sesiones y canales tipados
- [Backlog de extracción — CrewAI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/crewai.md): Candidatas del informe CrewAI: conformidad del adapter existente, consolidación con invariantes de propiedad, recibo durable de saves, recall autorizado y capability de herramientas
- [Backlog de extracción — Dify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/dify.md): Candidatas del informe Dify: plan efectivo de retrieval, diagnóstico con privacidad, publicación de derivados por revisión, metadata tipada y caché de embedding con identidad
- [Backlog de extracción — Faiss](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/faiss.md): Candidatas del informe Faiss: generación de caches vectoriales, semántica de score, identidad estable en mutaciones, admisión de representaciones y diagnóstico de terminación
- [Backlog de extracción — Flowise](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/flowise.md): Candidatas del informe Flowise: outcome por fuente, configuración efectiva de observabilidad, binding ejecución/state/memoria, recibo de mutación y binding autorizado por transporte
- [Backlog de extracción — GraphRAG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/graphrag.md): Seis candidatas del informe GraphRAG: snapshot de comunidad, proyección de contexto, invalidación por revisión, exploración, síntesis map/reduce y envelope de caché
- [Backlog de extracción — Graphify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/graphify.md): Candidatas del informe Graphify: importación con evidencia por arista, contrato de productor, consultas con cobertura declarada, reconciliación por capa, publicación de derivados, relaciones paralelas e inspector
- [Backlog de extracción — Graphiti](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/graphiti.md): Cinco candidatas del informe Graphiti: resolución temporal de hechos, identidad en dedup, retirada de soporte, traza por brazo e inspector Studio
- [Backlog de extracción — Hindsight](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/hindsight.md): Siete candidatas del informe Hindsight: publicación con fuentes vivas, traza de fusión, outcome de refresh, ventana temporal, partición por ámbito, validación de extracción y reflect con cancelación
- [Backlog de extracción — Khoj](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/khoj.md): Siete candidatas del informe Khoj: gramática de filtros, recibo de sync, citas por revisión, política de memoria, parser acotado, identidad de caché y ack por operación
- [Backlog de extracción — LanceDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/lancedb.md): Siete candidatas del informe LanceDB: coordenada de lectura, frescura de derivados, recibo de reemplazo, proyección por etapas, explain efectivo, disponibilidad de índice y reparación cercada
- [Backlog de extracción — LangChain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/langchain.md): Siete candidatas del informe LangChain: grupos causales de compactación, proyección de tools, decisión vs recibo, append por revisión, contabilidad de intentos, score tipado y capa de touch
- [Backlog de extracción — LangGraph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/langgraph.md): Siete candidatas del informe LangGraph: conformidad versionada del adapter, writes intermedios, replay/aprobación, capacidades de store y serde, visibilidad de batch, borrado de thread y linaje de checkpoints
- [Backlog de extracción — Langflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/langflow.md): Cinco candidatas del informe Langflow: capacidad de filtro por adaptador, descriptores sin conexión, fencing de generaciones para derivados, recibo de lote conversacional e historial de ingesta por item
- [Backlog de extracción — Letta](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/letta.md): Candidatas X-LET-01–12 y X-LET-20–22 del informe Letta: publicación por revisión, validación, reparación por firma, compactación, estados separados, recall con cobertura y eco; escritura con recibo, undo/redo, almacén degradable, consolidación por delta e invalidación fan-out de V1 archive; reflection/sleeptime con merge gobernado, validación en frontera y navegación diferida de letta-code
- [Backlog de extracción — LightRAG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/light-rag.md): Siete candidatas del informe LightRAG: expansión relacional autorizada, ledger de contribuciones, manifest de entrega citada, degradación por etapa, retirada con intención recuperable, materialización opt-in y derivados multimodales
- [Backlog de extracción — LlamaIndex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/llama-index.md): Siete candidatas del informe LlamaIndex: fidelidad del adapter, identidad/recibo de transformación, expansión con trazabilidad, preview de ingesta, recibo por etapa, proyección de metadata por destino y evidencia de copia en compactación
- [Backlog de extracción — Meilisearch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/meilisearch.md): Candidatas del informe de extracción de Meilisearch convertidas en filas ejecutables, con trazabilidad a la evidencia del clon local
- [Backlog de extracción — Mem0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/mem0.md): Seis candidatas del informe Mem0: política de conservación, diagnóstico de candidatura, recibo de mutación parcial, pertenencia inmutable por ID, proyección de entidades reparable y purga verificable
- [Backlog de extracción — MemPalace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/mempalace.md): Seis candidatas del informe MemPalace: capacidades e identidad de espacio de embedding, piso de evidencia raw, reindexación recuperable por fuente, handle lógico de evidencia, relevo temporal y preview de importación
- [Backlog de extracción — Milvus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/milvus.md): Candidatas A–G del informe Milvus: readiness compuesto de ingesta, barrera read-after-write, publicación con ownership, prefijo de consumo, retry seguro, motivo de mantenimiento y proyección pública
- [Backlog de extracción — OpenAI Agents Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/openai-agents-python.md): Candidatas A–E del informe OpenAI Agents Python: rewind por propiedad de sufijo, publicación de compaction, vista de handoff, publicación recuperable de resultados de herramientas y observabilidad gobernada
- [Backlog de extracción — OpenViking](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/openviking.md): Candidatas F1–F10 del informe de extracción OpenViking más las unidades de escritorio separables derivadas del eje 10, con trazabilidad a la evidencia del clone b8e8895
- [Backlog de extracción — PageIndex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/pageindex.md): Candidatas A–D del informe PageIndex: spans de fuente versionados, publicación coherente de generaciones documentales, navegación estructurada como adapter de recall y presupuesto de ejecución del host
- [Backlog de extracción — Qdrant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/qdrant.md): Candidatas A–E del informe Qdrant: explicación de decisión filtrada, fronteras de aceptación/durabilidad (C13), contribuciones de fusión, materialización tardía y targets congelados de mutaciones por filtro
- [Backlog de extracción — Quivr](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/quivr.md): Candidatas del informe Quivr: recibo revisionado y retiro absorbente de fuente, publicación por generación, observaciones retractables, entrega durable firmada, resolución viva redactada y anclas de fuente
- [Backlog de extracción — RAGFlow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/extraccion/backlogs/ragflow.md): Candidatas A–E del informe RAGFlow: publicación cercada de derivados, recibo de evidencia servida por turno, gate de capacidades por producto, prune condicionado a inventario completo y observación reconciliable de ingesta

- [Auditoria de los 9 adaptadores y las skills - 2026-10-21](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/reviews/audit-adapters-skills-20261021.md): Auditoria de solo lectura de la superficie publica: integrations/** (9 adaptadores de framework Python), skills/** y la paridad core <-> bindings. 10 hallazgos High, 16 Medium, 11 Low y 4 sospechas. El gap que FIND-506 declaraba queda cerrado. La clase de bug dominante es 'mismo dato, distinto resultado' entre superficies.
- [Auditoria profunda de VantaDB v0.9.0 - 141 hallazgos (multi-subagente)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/reviews/2026-10-20-auditoria-profunda-v0.9.0.md): Revision read-only de 12 areas del sistema con 8 subagentes: 2 P0, 39 P1, 59 P2, 41 P3. - [Auditoria profunda de la frontera FFI y los bindings - 2026-10-21](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/reviews/audit-ffi-bindings-20261021.md): Auditoria de solo lectura de vantadb-ffi-core, vantadb-node, vantadb-ts y vantadb-wasm. La frontera es memoria-segura por construccion (cero unsafe en los 3 transportes), pero hay divergencia silenciosa de contrato entre backends y stubs que fabrican datos. 7 hallazgos High, 10 Medium, 6 Low. Cierra FIND-504.
- [Auditoria profunda de la gramatica IQL (src/parser) - 2026-10-21](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/reviews/audit-grammar-iql-20261021.md): Auditoria de solo lectura de src/parser (gramatica, lexer, AST) y su contrato con el planner y el executor. 14 hallazgos (1 critico, 8 altos), 3 formas documentadas que no parsean, 11 comportamientos aceptados que la doc no documenta y 6 divergencias de semantica. Cierra FIND-502.
- [Auditoria profunda de physical_plan, planner y executor - 2026-10-21](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/dev/reviews/audit-physical-plan-20261021.md): Auditoria de solo lectura del nucleo de ejecucion de queries: physical_plan (10 operadores), planner (CBO) y executor. 20 hallazgos (4 criticos, 5 altos, 7 medios, 4 bajos): la proyeccion anula el filtro temporal, el path vectorial no scopea por entidad, el CBO puede eliminar un predicado y la reserva del governor se fuga si la query falla. Cierra 2 de los 12 modulos de FIND-503.

## Tutorials

- [Building AI Agent Memory with VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/01-ai-agent-memory.md): VantaDB gives AI agents persistent memory — the ability to store, recall, and search across past conversations, decisions, and context. Unlike stateless LLM calls, an agent backed by VantaDB remembers what happened last session...
- [Embedding Integrations — BYO-Vector + embed-local](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/05-embedding-integrations.md): VantaDB does not embed text for you by default. This is intentional (BYO-vector): you control the embedding model, dimension, and lifecycle. Bring your own vector=[...] on put() and queryvector on search()
- [Hybrid Search with VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/04-hybrid-search-basics.md): Vector search finds meaning; keyword search finds exact terms. Most real queries need both. VantaDB fuses HNSW vector search with BM25 lexical search in a single call, so you get semantic recall and precise term matching without running...
- [LM Studio + VantaDB — Persistent Memory for Your Local GUI Stack](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/06-lm-studio.md): Pattern tutorial: apps consuming LM Studio's OpenAI-compatible local server + VantaDB as persistent, searchable memory (rescued from the 2026-06 GTM research, updated to 0.7.x API).
- [Local RAG Pipeline with VantaDB + Ollama](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/02-local-rag-pipeline.md): Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) lets you ask natural language questions over your own documents — without sending data to a third-party API. This tutorial builds a fully local RAG pipeline using
- [Migrating from ChromaDB to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/03-migrating-from-chromadb.md): Move a ChromaDB persistent store into VantaDB with the bundled migration helper — commands, limits, and readback checks.
- [Migrating from LanceDB to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/migration-from-lancedb.md): If you're using LanceDB today, switching to VantaDB unlocks GraphRAG traversal, built-in hybrid search (BM25 + HNSW), TTL-based record expiry, and the VantaDB PyPI integration ecosystem — while keeping your existing vector workflow...
- [Migrating from Letta to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/migrating-from-letta.md): Export a Letta agent file (.af), convert its memory blocks and message history with the built-in importer, and import them into VantaDB
- [Migrating from Mem0 to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/migrating-from-mem0.md): Export your Mem0 memories without credentials, convert them with the built-in importer, and import them into VantaDB — metadata, timestamps and provenance preserved
- [Migrating from Vectara to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/migrate-from-vectara.md): Vectara shut down its self-service RAG-as-a-Service tier in 2026 and repositioned as an enterprise agent platform. If you were on the self-service tier, you need a new home for your corpora. VantaDB is a drop-in local-first replacement...
- [Migrating from Zep / Graphiti to VantaDB](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ness-e/Vantadb/main/docs/user/tutorials/migrating-from-zep.md): Export your Zep or Graphiti graph without credentials, convert episodes and facts — valid-time windows and episode provenance included — and import them into VantaDB
